verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents targeting rules that serve flag variations based on context attributes, with precedence and conditions across context kinds. It also documents segment targeting and converting rules into segments. Hands-on community reports corroborate ordered rules with ANDed conditions over arbitrary contexts, attribute-based rollouts, and Big Segments. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how segments are created and reused across multiple flags (the segment evidence is mostly titles and brief mentions).

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: This topic explains how to use flag targeting rules to serve flag variations to different contexts based on their attributes.
In addition to targeting specific context attributes, you can target individuals, segments, or specific mobile apps and devices.
Create as many feature flags as you need and target them by user, segment, or rule.
Targeting rules are the mechanism for expressing precedence and conditions across multiple context kinds.
